body.name: zetaDelta
body.type: canonical gradient of the gap functional
body.def: \(\zeta_{\Delta,b^{\mathrm{cmp}}}\in\mathcal T_P\) is the Riesz representer satisfying \(E_P[\zeta_{\Delta,b^{\mathrm{cmp}}}s]=\left.\partial_u\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp}}(P_u)\right|_{u=0}\) for every regular score \(s\in\mathcal T_P\).
